verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's evidence shows AI features like note-taking, voice interviewing, and offer forecasting, plus an 'AI-powered report filters' pricing line item, but nothing documents a natural-language command interface for operating the product (e.g., a conversational agent to manage candidates, jobs, or workflows via NL commands). Missing for 10: any documentation of a chat/NL command interface, examples of NL-driven actions, or API/agent tooling exposing conversational control.
